original_card.question: Can a template or call contract leave two or more unpaid coordinates per live family?
methods: State a replacement for the coverage identity (mass = 72W + 64N) and the contract change that realizes it, with its implementation cost.
Find an obstruction: show which data-endpoint obligation forces exactly one unpaid coordinate in the current template.
original_card.acceptance_gate: An explicit replacement identity, verified on a small complete instance with dirty inputs, priced with ceiling.ceiling(unpaid=...). A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Explain where the single unpaid coordinate per family comes from in the hosted template; propose one change and price it. Ideal budget: two unpaid coordinates per family is 3.77x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The deficit is one coordinate per family minus the centre charge; doubling unpaid coordinates per family scales it directly.
allowed_variations: One template change or one endpoint-contract change.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Counting a coordinate as unpaid while leaving it unadvanced in the data endpoint.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: Prove the sharp complete-plane actual-reader floor whenever either augmented factor/target labelled matroid has a characteristic-two representation, with arbitrary term count, target count and external dimensions. Test a non-TU near-regular rank-five/four-target family.
scope_change_reason: A scoped decoder obstruction to changed coverage, not a new unpaid-coordinate supplier. PR3491 leaves nonregular/external dictionaries open; this replaces its TU and target-span hypotheses by a full labelled representation condition. It does not assert that full representability is necessary for a support transfer.
bottleneck_link: Any hoped-for saving in this additive complete-plane decoder tariff must use augmented configurations with no characteristic-two representation on both sides. This is a scoped search boundary; complete native/consumer costs remain unknown.
stop_rule: Finish the transfer implication and one explicit nonregular external-direction certificate. Stop before any physical construction or broader census; reject if support inclusion, exact operator or minor equivalence fails.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the universal implication. RESULT.json and two separately implemented checkers certify 15503 polynomial minors, 32768 subset ranks, 16384 source/reader requests, six exact operators, support domination and all expanded-I224 entries.

open_questions.question: Can a cheaper literal factorization have neither augmented side representable in characteristic two, while every actual reader is charged?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Such a saving is necessary before expanding this fixed additive-tariff decoder route into a native implementation.
open_questions.first_step: Exhibit one exact rational factorization outside the representation hypothesis and compute its full rectangular complete-plane reader bill; selective transfer may still rule it out.
open_questions.blocked_by: No cheaper literal factorization is supplied. Full nonrepresentability does not imply failure of selective support transfer. Native acquisition, restoration, frames and consumer costs remain unpriced.
